shield_port.title: Shield port
shield_port.description: The port the Shield app on this computer listens on. When set, the extension talks to Shield on this port only (always this computer, never another address) and the person cannot change it.

managed_by.title: Managed by
managed_by.description: The name of the organisation that manages this computer, shown in the extension window so the person knows who set it up.

coriqo_link.title: Connect to Coriqo
coriqo_link.description: "disabled" turns off signing in to Coriqo and linking this computer from the extension; the Connect to Coriqo buttons then say the organisation turned it off. Default enabled.

coriqo_api_base.title: Coriqo address
coriqo_api_base.description: The exact https origin of the Coriqo server, such as https://app.coriqo.io. When set it overrides the person's setting and cannot be changed. Any other value turns linking off.
